answer: Cosignatures are collected in karst, verified in canyon, and beacon names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 47 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 4 hours of verification and 16 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
